cases.name: eval-prints-value
cases.doc: CLI parity: 'eval -e EXPR' prints the value of EXPR to stdout

cases.name: version-expr-41-2
cases.doc: CLI parity: (version) returns the kernel version 41.2 uniformly (works on every impl, incl. shen-lua which has no --version flag)

cases.name: version-banner-contains
cases.doc: CLI parity: the --version banner contains the kernel version 41.2. shen-lua has no --version flag, so Bifrost falls back to eval of (version).

cases.name: stdin-eof-clean-exit
cases.doc: DELIBERATE IMPROVEMENT OVER CANONICAL (not a spec conformance): starting the REPL and closing stdin (EOF) exits cleanly on every maintained impl. Canonical Shen LOOPS FOREVER here — the kernel shen.loop catches the reader's EOF error, prints it, and recurses (e.g. official shen-cl emits ~26MB of 'NIL is not of type CHARACTER' in 8s). All ports here detect EOF at the input layer and exit 0; this case guards that they keep doing so. (Earlier this passed spuriously for shen-cl because its repl adapter used a bare -q, which shen-cl rejects as an invalid arg and exits before the REPL even starts — now fixed to bare {bin}.)
